entry.title: Green tomato chutney
entry.summary: What to do with the tomatoes that won't ripen.
entry.content:
Every October there's a bowl of green tomatoes that won't ripen. This is where they go.

  1. Chop 1 kg of green tomatoes, 2 onions and 2 apples.
  2. Simmer with 300 ml cider vinegar, 250 g brown sugar and a spoon each of mustard seeds and salt.
  3. Cook gently for about two hours, until thick, then spoon into clean jars.

Leave it a month before opening. It's better for the wait.

entry.title: What the tomatoes taught me this year
entry.summary: Three varieties, one wet August, and a list for next spring.
entry.content:
Three varieties went in this year. Here's how they did:

Variety Planted First ripe Verdict
Gardener's Delight April July Grow again
San Marzano April August Worth it for sauce
Black Krim May September Too late for our summer

For next spring

  • Start seeds two weeks earlier.
  • Fewer plants, more space between them.
  • Mulch before the first heat, not after.

entry.title: Welcome to the blog
entry.summary: What this blog is, and how it's made.
entry.content:
This is the first post. Replace it with your own: open the Blog tab in your Pagehaus dashboard, choose a post, and write. Press Publish and the page, the list of posts and the RSS feed update together.

Posts are written in Markdown, so a line with ## in front makes a heading, **two stars** make bold text, and [words](https://example.com) make a link. Paste an image into the editor to add it.
